chapters.summary: The day of the LORD is near - God will judge the sins of Judah and Jerusalem, including idolatry and complacency, calling the people to seek righteousness and humility before his wrath falls.
keyPoints: Declares that the day of the LORD is near, bringing destruction on the whole earth and judgment on Judah and Jerusalem.
Rebukes the sins of idolatry, mixed worship, and complacency, including bowing down to Baal and Malcham.
Warns that the day of judgment cannot be escaped, calling the people to repent and seek the LORD before his wrath comes.
chapters.application: Let us examine our own lives - have we grown complacent, or turned to idols of our own? While the LORD may still be found, let us humbly repent and seek him with our whole heart, that we may escape the wrath to come.

chapters.summary: Zephaniah calls the people to humbly seek God, declares judgment on the nations, and promises that a faithful remnant will be restored.
keyPoints: Calls the people to seek the LORD in humility, that they might perhaps be sheltered before the day of judgment.
Declares judgment on Philistia, Moab, Ammon, Ethiopia, and Assyria.
Promises that the remnant will be restored, enjoying God's favor and peace.
chapters.application: In times of hardship, let us humbly seek God and walk in righteousness, trusting his promises - he will surely shelter and restore us.

chapters.summary: Zephaniah 3 declares Jerusalem's sin and coming punishment, yet promises that a remnant will be saved, and foretells that God will restore Israel and draw all peoples to himself.
keyPoints: Jerusalem is rebellious and defiled, oppressing others, refusing to listen to God's voice, rejecting correction, and failing to trust in the LORD.
God righteously judges the nations and destroys wickedness, yet preserves a humble remnant who take refuge in his name.
God promises to restore Israel, to dwell among his people, to bring salvation, and to cause all peoples to call on his name.
chapters.application: Even in the midst of darkness, God still reigns. Let us draw near to him with a humble and repentant heart, trusting in his presence and salvation, and living out righteousness and joy in our daily lives.
